blind.description: A set of wall-mounted dungeon manacles consisting of a rectangular mounting plate with corner rivets, a central looped bracket, and two short hanging chains ending in open metal wrist cuffs or shackles. The model has a weathered bronze/iron metal texture and solid, continuous geometry.
blind.from_above: From straight above it appears as a thin rectangular block representing the top edge of the mounting bracket, with the rounded outlines of the chains and cuffs visible immediately beneath it.
defects: floating in mid-air without a supporting wall
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third the height of the figure (around 1.8 feet tall) and under 1 foot wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.86x off the catalog (1.5 x 0.7 ft)
